title: Potentials-Based Computer Modelling of Lanthanide Doped Mixed Metal Fluorides and Oxides for Optical Applications
content: This article presents a review of the field of potentials-based computer modelling as applied to the doping by lanthanides, of a range of metal oxides and fluorides, with a view to enhancing various properties for optical applications. The following host compounds are considered: BaLiF3, BaY2F8, SrAl2O4 and LiNbO3.
